name: Air Alderaan StarSpeeder 1000
description: The Air Alderaan StarSpeeder 1000 was a modified StarSpeeder 1000 spaceliner used by interstellar travel agency Star Tours to operate passenger flights between 2 to 0 BBY. It was named after the Core World planet Alderaan as well as Air Alderaan, the official spaceline for the Imperial Senate, which was a fellow member with Star Tours in the Galactic Tourist Bureau.
